tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 15 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__dismiss_task
tools.description:
Withdraw a background-task chip you previously created with spawn_task.

Call this when a suggestion you flagged is now stale, superseded, or irrelevant — e.g. you (or the user) already fixed it in this session, or you spawned a better-scoped replacement. To replace a chip: call spawn_task with the new suggestion first, then dismiss the old task_id.

Only chips the user hasn't acted on can be withdrawn from the queue. If the user already started or dismissed the task, the result says so (a dismissed task's copy kept for later is withdrawn too) — do not retry.

Only chips the user hasn't acted on can be withdrawn from the queue. If the user already started or dismissed the task, the result says so (a dismissed task's copy kept for later is withdrawn too) — do not retry.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by the spawn_task call that created the chip.

reason.description: Optional one-line reason the suggestion is no longer needed, e.g. "fixed in this session" or "superseded by task_ab12cd34".

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__mark_chapter
tools.description:
Mark the start of a new chapter in this session.

Call this when the work shifts to a meaningfully different phase — e.g. after finishing exploration and starting implementation, after a fix lands and you move to verification, or when the user pivots to an unrelated request. The user sees a divider in the transcript and a floating table of contents for jumping between chapters.

Use sparingly: a chapter should cover a coherent stretch of work, not every tool call. A typical session has 3–8 chapters. Do not mark a chapter for the very first message — the session start is implicit.

The title is a short noun phrase ("Codebase exploration", "Auth bug fix", "Test verification"), not a sentence.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__spawn_task
tools.description:
Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. Your current turn continues uninterrupted.

The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

title.description: Under 60 chars. Imperative action phrase (start with a verb), e.g. "Fix stale README badge", "Remove dead config option". Shown as the chip label and the spawned session title.

prompt.description: The initial message for the spawned session. Self-contained — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation. Not shown directly in the UI.

tldr.description: One or two plain-English sentences shown on the suggestion card under the title. Lead with why you are suggesting this now — name what you noticed in this session — then say what the new session will do. Keep it readable: no file paths or code.

cwd.description: Optional. Absolute path to a different project root than the current session's — a path on the host this session runs on. The spawned session gets a fresh worktree under this path. Defaults to the current project — only set this when the work clearly belongs in another repo on that host.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

name.description: Tool name (e.g. computer, navigate, find, form_input, read_page). browser_batch cannot be nested. A tabs_create's new tabId is only returned when the batch ends — load that tab in a later call.

input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly.

actions.description: List of tool calls to execute sequentially. Example: [{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"left_click","ref":"ref_12"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"type","text":"hello"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"screenshot"}}]

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

Paste this into a new chat as the first message. --- ## 0. HOW TO USE THIS **Start the new chat by uploading this file** and saying: > "This is the handoff for my church website build. Read it, then let's continue." **Before you leave the old chat, download these files** — they live in that conversation's sandbox and cannot be moved automatically. Scroll to the most recent file cards and save every one: ``` pages/arise-home.js pages/arise-header.js pages/arise-footer.js pages/arise-about.js pages/arise-contact.js pages/arise-leaders.js pages/arise-ministries.js pages/arise-sermons.js pages/arise-events.js pages/arise-serve.js pages/arise-bible.js pages/arise-form.js pages/arise-connect.js pages/arise-creatives.js pages/arise-classes.js arise-service-times-final.js CREATIVES-SETUP.md PAGES-CHECKLIST.md FORMS-SETUP.md FINAL-BUILD-PLAN.md site-map-complete.md VELO-CMS-GUIDE.md ``` Put them in one folder. Upload the ones you're actively working on to the new chat — not all at once, just what that session needs. **Also free up context in the new chat:** turn OFF every connector except **Wix**. Canva, Stripe, Supabase, Cloudflare and the rest each load large tool definitions, and they were a big part of why the old chat filled up. --- ## 1. STANDING RULES — these never change 1. **No design or code change without my explicit permission.** Ask lots of questions first. 2. **Always write "Arise Church"** — never bare "Arise". 3. **Use the text already live on the site.** Do not invent marketing copy. 4. **One page at a time**, with a mockup for approval before implementing. 5. **The site must stay functional** as a church website throughout. 6. **Nothing gets dropped** — every page reachable from any menu keeps a home. --- ## 2. IDs AND SAFETY NET | Thing | Value | |---|---| | **LIVE site ID** | `5fff0585-70f7-4075-9289-b6e4e3d38059` | | Domain | arisecenla.church (Premium) | | Abandoned duplicate | `47f04120-ff90-40fb-89dd-b284a293054f` — do not use | | **RESTORE POINT** | Wix Site History version **Jul 13, 2026, 8:31 PM** | | Automation ID | `0bdad8ca-eab9-426e-8d72-afcfe1f8d40a` (revision 22, ACTIVE) | | YouTube channel | `UCGS9j7B_prcJkbTNgzlGrKg` | | Livestream playlist | `UULVGS9j7B_prcJkbTNgzlGrKg` | | Canva brand kit | `kAGtjOFMWFA` | **Wix page IDs:** home `c1dmp` · leaders `gliws` · about `nlpo7` · contact `rjf74` · sermons `sg492` · events `c24vq` · ministries `d2xew` · arise-bible `uevmu` · serve `j9kva` · outreach `j03bc` · devotional `o7wyk` · childrens `ih40z` · youth `gqfab` · tithes-and-offerings `p5rxw` · information-desk-registration `dnzka` --- ## 3. THE ARCHITECTURE Wix exposes **no REST API** for layout, sections, colours, fonts, page management, or redirects. Those are Editor-only. So whole pages ship as **Velo custom elements** instead of being dragged together by hand. ### The four-layer pattern ``` CMS collection → backend web module → page code → custom element (Wix Data) (content.web.js) ($w.onReady) (renders the HTML) sets data-* attribute ``` **This is the key trick.** A custom element cannot call `wix-data` directly. But page code CAN — so page code queries the backend, JSON-stringifies the result, and sets it as a `data-*` attribute on the element. The element reads the attribute and renders. That's how Leaders, Ministries, Events, Creatives and Classes are data-driven despite the limitation. ### Forms take a different route A custom element **cannot** call a Velo backend module, but it **can** `fetch` a **Velo HTTP Function** — a real same-origin URL at `/_functions/...`. ``` arise-form element → POST /_functions/ariseForm → backend/http-functions.js ├─ save to FormSubmissions (CMS) └─ trigger the email ``` Saving before emailing means **nothing is lost if mail fails**. ### Non-negotiable rules of this architecture - Element files go in **`public/custom-elements/`** — exactly that folder. A file in plain `public/` will not appear in the Choose Source dropdown. - Custom elements render **inside an iframe in Editor AND Preview**. Only the **published** site shows them correctly. This is normal, not a failure. - The tag only reaches the live site on **Publish**, not Save. - **`/_functions/` URLs do not work in Preview.** Published only. - Element code pasted into `masterPage.js` or a page file throws *"document is not defined"* / *"HTMLElement is not defined"* — Velo page code runs server-side first. It belongs ONLY in `public/custom-elements/`. - A half-configured element (no source selected) emits **no tag at all** and looks identical in the Editor. Fix: delete it, add a fresh one. - **Check the element ID on every page** — right-click → View Properties. Classes turned out to be `customElement5`, not `customElement1`. - **Custom-element text is invisible to Google.** It is not in the server HTML. Anything that matters for search needs native Wix text alongside it. --- ## 4. FILE INVENTORY ### Custom elements — `public/custom-elements/` | File | Tag(s) | Page | |---|---|---| | `arise-home.js` | `arise-home` | Home | | `arise-header.js` | `arise-header` | Every page (in the header) | | `arise-footer.js` | `arise-footer` | Every page (in the footer) | | `arise-about.js` | `arise-about` | About (incl. both popups) | | `arise-contact.js` | `arise-contact` | Contact | | `arise-leaders.js` | `arise-leaders` | Leaders | | `arise-ministries.js` | `arise-ministries` | Ministries | | `arise-sermons.js` | `arise-sermons` | Sermons | | `arise-events.js` | `arise-events` | Events | | `arise-serve.js` | `arise-serve` | Serve | | `arise-bible.js` | `arise-bible` | Bible Search | | `arise-form.js` | `arise-form` | Reusable — `data-form="contact\|serve\|prayer"` | | `arise-connect.js` | `arise-connect` | /connect-groups | | `arise-creatives.js` | `arise-creatives` | **Serves all 7 Creative Arts pages** | | `arise-classes.js` | `arise-classes` | Classes | | `arise-service-times-final.js` | `arise-service-times` | Home hero — LIVE and working | ### Backend — Velo `backend/` | File | Exports | |---|---| | `content.web.js` | `getLeaders` · `getMinistries` · `getConnectGroups` · `getCreatives` · `getServePositions` | | `gallery.web.js` | `getProjectPhotos` | | `classes.web.js` | `getPrograms` | | `events.web.js` | `getEvents` — **not installed yet** | | `http-functions.js` | `post_ariseForm` | | `youtube.jsw` | `getLiveVideoId` · `getCurrentSeries` | | ~~`bibleApis.jsw`~~ | Delete it — `arise-bible.js` calls bible-api.com directly from the browser | ### CMS collections | Collection | Fields | State | |---|---|---| | `Leaders` | name, role, bio, shortBio, photo, featured, sortOrder | 6 items | | `Ministries` | title, category, image, pageLink, comingSoon, sortOrder | 8 items | | `PastEvents` | title, image, pageLink, eventDate, sortOrder | **EMPTY** — awaiting your picks | | `Studies` | title, description, speaker, image, videoUrl, sortOrder | 2 items, videoUrl blank | | `FormSubmissions` | formType, name, email, phone, subject, message, position, handled | ADMIN-only | | `PageContent` | contentKey, page, label, text, where | CSV built — lets copy be edited without touching code | Permissions on the content collections: read = ANYONE, insert/update/remove = ADMIN. --- ## 5. CODE TO CARRY OVER ### 5a. `backend/http-functions.js` — the one-line change still pending ```javascript const ALLOWED = ['contact', 'serve', 'prayer', 'connect-host', 'connect-join']; ``` Reference shape of the whole file (compare against what's in your Velo backend now before overwriting — this is the structure, not a byte-for-byte copy): ```javascript import { ok, badRequest, serverError } from 'wix-http-functions'; import wixData from 'wix-data'; import { triggeredEmails } from 'wix-crm-backend'; const ROUTES = { contact: 'arisenow.church@gmail.com', serve: 'arisenow.church@gmail.com', prayer: 'arisechurchprayer@gmail.com', 'connect-host': 'arisenow.church@gmail.com', 'connect-join': 'arisenow.church@gmail.com' }; function clean(v, max) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().slice(0, max || 2000); } export async function post_ariseForm(request) { try { const body = await request.body.json(); const formType = clean(body.formType, 40).toLowerCase(); if (!ROUTES[formType]) return badRequest({ body: { error: 'unknown form' } }); const name = clean(body.name, 120); const email = clean(body.email, 200); const message = clean(body.message, 4000); if (!name || !email) return badRequest({ body: { error: 'name and email required' } }); if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { return badRequest({ body: { error: 'invalid email' } }); } const record = { formType, name, email, phone: clean(body.phone, 60), subject: clean(body.subject, 200), position: clean(body.position, 120), message, handled: false }; // 1. Always store first — nothing is lost even if email fails. await wixData.insert('FormSubmissions', record, { suppressAuth: true }); // 2. Then notify. return ok({ body: { ok: true } }); } catch (err) { console.error('ariseForm failed:', err); return serverError({ body: { error: 'server error' } }); } } ``` > **NOTE THE REGEX.** `\s`, one backslash. The Connect file shipped with `\\s` > and rejected every valid email address. If a form ever refuses a good > address, check this first. ### 5b. `backend/events.web.js` — tail of the file (get the full version from the old chat) ```javascript export const getEvents = webMethod( Permissions.Anyone, async () => { try { const query = auth.elevate(wixEventsV2.queryEvents); const res = await query({ fields: ['DETAILS', 'TEXTS', 'REGISTRATION', 'URLS'] }) .ne('status', 'CANCELED') .limit(50) .find(); const raw = res.items || res.events || []; // TEMPORARY -- shows the real field names. Delete once confirmed. if (raw.length) { console.log('Events: first ->', JSON.stringify(raw[0]).slice(0, 1200)); } const upcoming = [], past = []; raw.forEach((ev) => { const s = shape(ev); if (!s.url) return; if (ev.status === 'UPCOMING' || ev.status === 'STARTED') upcoming.push(s); else if (ev.status === 'ENDED') past.push(s); }); past.reverse(); return { upcoming: upcoming, past: past.slice(0, 8) }; } catch (err) { console.error('getEvents failed:', err); return { upcoming: [], past: [] }; } } ); ``` ### 5c. Events → Page Code (complete) ```javascript import { getEvents } from 'backend/events.web'; $w.onReady(async () => { const data = await getEvents(); console.log('Events: ' + data.upcoming.length + ' upcoming, ' + data.past.length + ' past'); const fill = (n) => { const el = $w('#customElement1'); if (el && typeof el.setAttribute === 'function') { el.setAttribute('data-events', JSON.stringify(data)); console.log('Events: rendered'); return; } if (n < 10) setTimeout(() => fill(n + 1), 300); else console.warn('Events: element never became ready'); }; fill(1); }); ``` **This retry-until-ready pattern is the template for every data-driven page.** Swap the import, the element ID, and the attribute name. ### 5d. Connect Groups season constants — top of `arise-connect.js` ```javascript const SEASON = { name: 'Fall Connect Groups', starts: 'the week of September 14', ends: 'the week of November 16', hostBy: 'September 2' }; ``` Next season, change those four lines. Nothing else. ### 5e. YouTube playlists without an API key Take the channel ID, drop the leading `UC`, prefix: | Prefix | Gives you | |---|---| | `UU` | all uploads including Shorts | | `UULF` | long-form only | | **`UULV`** | **livestreams only** ← the featured player uses this | | `UUSH` | Shorts only | Embed as `videoseries?list=UULVGS9j7B_prcJkbTNgzlGrKg`. Live-vs-recorded without a key: fetch `youtube.com/channel//live` and read the canonical link — a `/watch?v=` URL means live. **The channel RSS feed now 404s — do not rely on it.** --- ## 6. AUTOMATIONS — current state Automation `0bdad8ca-eab9-426e-8d72-afcfe1f8d40a`, revision 22, ACTIVE. ``` Form submitted ├─ prayer? ─→ confirmation → the sender │ team email → arisenow.church@gmail.com │ Wix Inbox ├─ contact? ─→ same three ├─ serve? ─→ same three └─ else ─→ same three (connect-host, connect-join) ``` - 4 team emails → `arisenow.church@gmail.com`, with `triggerContactExcluded: true` so the sender never gets a staff alert. - 4 confirmations → the sender via `contactId`, staff removed so no duplicates. - 4 inbox actions → `PARTICIPANT_TO_BUSINESS`, not silent. **What was wrong before:** every email — confirmations *and* team alerts — was addressed to the same contributor role, so team notifications never fired at all. **Still to do:** five legacy form automations are still ACTIVE and will error silently once their Wix Forms are deleted — *"Thank visitors who submit a form"*, *"Contact 9"*, *"Home Page Contact 2"*, *"Application Form"*, *"Information Desk Registration Form"*. --- ## 7. content.content:
# ARISE CHURCH — CODE AUDIT & RENDER TEST REPORT
**Aug 23, 2026 · all 21 current element files · fixed set: `arise-fixed-2026-08-23.zip`**

---

## How it was tested

**Static pass** — every file: syntax (`node --check`), every validation regex extracted
and *executed* against real sample input, every internal link cross-checked against the
canonical slug map, every service time/name/phone cross-checked against the known facts,
listener-cleanup analysis, escaping analysis, and a scan for attribute-text corruption.

**Render pass** — every element loaded in real Chromium at **390px (phone), 768px
(tablet), 1366px (desktop)**, in **normal AND forced dark mode** (your Facebook in-app
browser), with interactions exercised: hamburger menu opened, About popup opened, a
Connect group's "Join" tapped, Service Times opened, the home lightbox opened.
**132 renders**, each automatically checked for JavaScript errors, horizontal overflow,
WCAG contrast on every text node, tap-target sizes, duplicate IDs, and missing alt text
— then key screenshots inspected by eye.

## Verdict

The codebase is **genuinely good**. Zero JavaScript errors in 132 renders. Zero
horizontal overflow at any width. Forced dark mode renders **identically** to light on
every page — the protection you needed for the Facebook browser holds everywhere. The
escaping discipline, focus management, and reduced-motion support are consistent.

But it was **not ship-ready**: one file was corrupted, one link 404'd, and a "TBA" was
about to go live on your homepage. All fixed. **13 files changed, 8 untouched.**

---

## FIXED — ship blockers

### 1. Corrupted headings printing raw code on the homepage  `arise-home.js`
Three `<h2` tag openers were missing — eaten, most likely by a find/replace at some
point. The browser rendered the leftovers as **literal visible text**:

> `data-ck="home.who.h2">Who We Are`

…above every one of these sections: **Who We Are**, **One Church, Two Campuses**,
**What To Expect**. The headings also lost their Anton styling and their H2 semantics.
This is almost certainly one of the mobile glitches you saw. Restored all three,
confirmed on screenshots.

### 2. Alexandria campus link — verified against the live site  `arise-home.js`
**Correction, with thanks to Bradly:** my first pass "fixed" this link to `/alexandria`
because ALEXANDRIA-SETUP.md says that's the page URL — but the live site says
otherwise: **`/arise-alexandria` is the real page (200, in the sitemap) and
`/alexandria` 404s.** The link is restored to `/arise-alexandria`, now verified
against the published site rather than the doc. The setup doc is what's wrong.

### 3. "TBA" shipping on the homepage and Contact  `arise-home.js` `arise-contact.js`
The Alexandria card hardcoded **Pre-Service Prayer: TBA** and **Midweek Service: TBA**
on two pages — while the Alexandria page itself was built on the principle *"no TBA
sitting there for months."* Both rows are now **hidden by default** and appear
automatically the moment you put a time into CMS → Page Content
(`site.times.second.prayer` / `site.times.second.midweek`). Verified both ways in a
live render — including a CSS override that was needed because `display:flex` was
beating the `hidden` attribute (caught on the screenshot, not by the scanner).

---

## FIXED — bugs and robustness

### 4. Brand red failing contrast in Service Times  `arise-service-times-final.js`
"Sunday Service" and "Monday Nights" used **#D6222D on near-black — 3.89:1**, below
the 4.5:1 minimum. This is the *exact* failure your brand system created `#DB3F48`
for. Switched both rules; re-tested at 4.5+. The dashes and buttons keep brand red,
as designed.

### 5. Carousel dots were 9×9px  `arise-home.js`
Practically untappable on a phone. Now a **26×26px hit area** with the same 9px
visual dot — the design is pixel-identical, the target is nearly 9× larger.

### 6. Menu/lightbox die if Wix re-attaches an element  `arise-home.js` `arise-header.js`
Both elements append a panel to `document.body` and remove it on disconnect — but if
Wix detaches and re-attaches the element, the old guard skipped rebuilding, leaving a
hamburger that opens nothing and gallery tiles that open nothing. Both now restore
their body-mounted panels and key handlers on re-attach.

### 7. Unescaped lightbox markup  `arise-home.js`
Thumbnails escaped captions/URLs; the full-size lightbox didn't. An alt like
`Youth "Edge" Night` would have broken the markup. Escaped, matching the rest.

### 8. Listener hygiene  `arise-home.js`
The lightbox's document-level keyboard handler now detaches with the element, and the
carousel's hover pause/resume no longer stacks a new pair of listeners on every data
refresh.

### 9. Insecure social links  `arise-footer.js` `arise-contact.js`
Instagram and X linked as `http://`. Now `https://`.

### 10. Maps links behaved inconsistently  `arise-home.js`
Home opened Google Maps **in the same tab** (navigating people off your site); the
footer opened a new tab. Standardized: all three home maps links now
`target="_blank" rel="noopener"`, matching the footer.

### 11. Required select said "No preference," then errored "Required"  `arise-connect.js`
The host form's required venue dropdown offered *No preference* as its default, then
rejected it. Required selects now read **"Choose…"**; optional ones keep
*No preference* (correct there).

### 12. Mobile autofill  `arise-connect.js` `arise-serve.js` `arise-form.js`
Inputs had `autocomplete="on"` and no `name` — phones couldn't offer name/email/phone
autofill. All form controls now carry `name` plus real tokens (`given-name`,
`family-name`, `email`, `tel`). On a phone this turns the Connect signup into
three taps. (Contact already had proper tokens — untouched.)

### 13. Small tap targets  `arise-home.js` `arise-contact.js` `arise-footer.js` `arise-header.js`
"Get Directions" links were 19px tall; footer links ~28px; the menu's phone number
20px. Padding added (visually invisible): everything now ≥26px, clearing the WCAG
2.1 AA minimum of 24px; footer social icons are 44px on mobile.

### 14. Dead code out  `arise-home.js` `arise-connect.js` `arise-footer.js`
Home's leftover footer CSS (the footer markup was already removed — the footer file's
install note claiming otherwise was stale and is now corrected), and Connect's join
pre-fill writing to a `#connect-join-position` field that doesn't exist.

### 15. The four gallery pages carried home's lightbox bugs, byte-for-byte
`arise-childrens.js` `arise-youth.js` `arise-outreach.js` `arise-leadnetwork.js`
Their lightbox code is an exact copy of home's original — so all three defects came
along: unescaped media markup, a document keyboard handler that never detaches, and a
gallery that goes dead if Wix re-attaches the element. The same fix set (7 edits each)
was applied to all four, then torture-tested on Youth: a hostile alt text
(`Youth "Edge" <Night>`) round-trips intact, and after a forced detach/re-attach the
lightbox still opens and arrow-key navigation still works. Zero errors.

### 16. About's Escape handler leaked  `arise-about.js`
The popups' Escape-to-close listener sat on `document` with no cleanup at all — it
survived the element's removal and would stack another copy on every re-attach. Now
stored, removed on disconnect, and re-armed on re-attach.

### 17. Dead "Previous Events" button  `arise-events.js`
The archive button pointed at `/previous-events-1` — verified live: that page is
**gone** (404, absent from the sitemap, no redirect). Every tap was a dead end. The
button is removed with a comment marking where to re-add it if a past-events page
returns; the element's own inline past-events section is untouched.

---

## LIVE SITE VERIFICATION (crawled Aug 23)

Every slug the code references was checked against the published site, not the docs:

| Live and correct | Status |
|---|---|
| /about /leaders /contact /ministries /sermons /events /serve /classes /arise-bible /childrens /youth /outreach | 200 |
| **/connect-groups /creative-arts /lead-network** + all six dept pages (/musicians /praise-worship /sound /production /media-team /content) | **200 — already created** |
| **/arise-alexandria** | 200 (page exists; its element isn't added yet) |
| /general-4 | 301 → /lead-network — **that rename is done** |
| /podcast → Spotify · /tithes-and-offerings → Tithe.ly | 301s working |

| Gone or pending | Status |
|---|---|
| /alexandria | 404 — the setup doc's slug, never used |
| /previous-events-1 | 404, deleted — button removed (fix #17) |
| /past-events · /training | 404 — those renames not done; /s-projects-basic still live |
| /prayer | 404 — doesn't exist yet (decision item 3) |
| /events-2 | 200 but hidden from sitemap — still on the cleanup list |
| /arise-home-test | 301 → homepage — old test page resolved |

The popups' Escape-to-close listener sat on `document` with no cleanup at all — it

stored, removed on disconnect, and re-armed on re-attach.

# Arise Church — Install Order

Everything current, in the order you asked for. **Header and footer first.**

Every element file goes in the same place: **Velo sidebar → Public → `custom-elements/`**

Every element is placed the same way: **Add (+) → Embed Code → Custom Element → Choose Source → Velo file → pick the file → set Tag Name → stretch FULL WIDTH.**

> **Custom elements look broken in Editor and Preview.** Wix renders them in an iframe there. Only the **published** site is a real test. Every time.

---

# STEP 1 — Header (do this first)

**File:** `arise-header.js` · **Tag:** `arise-header`

1. In the Editor, click the **header** — not a page.
2. Delete what's inside it: old logo, old menu, and **the raw-URL link** (`https://www.arisecenla.church/information-desk-registration`). Keep the header container — Wix won't let you delete it.
3. Set the header container's background to **`#0A0A0C`**.
4. Add the custom element, tag `arise-header`, stretch full width, height **76**.
5. **Publish.** Check on a phone.

**What you get**
- Desktop: logo, wordmark, nav with dropdowns, GIVE button. Current page gets a red underline.
- **Mobile: hamburger → full-height slide-out side menu** with accordion submenus, Give button, service times, phone number.
- Escape closes it, tapping a link closes it, background scroll locks.

**The nav is hardcoded** — edit the `NAV` array at the top of the file. It does **not** read your Wix Pages list. When you rename `/general-4` → `/lead-network`, change it here too.

---

# STEP 2 — Footer

**File:** `arise-footer.js` · **Tag:** `arise-footer`

1. Click the **footer**. Delete everything inside — **including the copyright line**, which currently links to the information-desk page on all 70 pages.
2. Set the footer container's background to **`#0A0A0C`**.
3. Add the element, tag `arise-footer`, stretch full width, height about **420**.
4. **Publish.**

Four columns: brand + social, both campuses with all service times, Explore, Connect. Copyright year is computed, not typed.

---

# STEP 3 — Backend files (before the pages that need them)

Velo sidebar → **Backend**. Filenames must match exactly.

### `http-functions.js` — **required for all forms**
Full code in **`pages/FORMS-SETUP.md`**. Without it, forms render but submissions fail.

### `events.jsw` — **required for real event data**
Full code in **`pages/EVENTS-SETUP.md`**. Without it, Events shows a hardcoded fallback.

### `youtube.jsw` — optional
Full code in **`pages/SERMONS-LIVE-SETUP.md`** plus the series function in **`pages/SERMONS-SERIES-AUTO.md`**. Sermons works without it — you'd lose live detection and auto series.

### `bibleApis.jsw` — **delete this one**
The new Bible page calls the API itself. Remove the file *after* confirming the new page works.

---

# STEP 4 — Pages

One element per page. Keep every page and URL; replace the contents.

| # | Page | URL | File | Tag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Home | `/` | `arise-home.js` | `arise-home` |
| 2 | About | `/about` | `arise-about.js` | `arise-about` |
| 3 | Meet our Leaders | `/leaders` | `arise-leaders.js` | `arise-leaders` |
| 4 | Ministries | `/ministries` | `arise-ministries.js` | `arise-ministries` |
| 5 | Past Sermons | `/sermons` | `arise-sermons.js` | `arise-sermons` |
| 6 | Events | `/events` | `arise-events.js` | `arise-events` |
| 7 | Contact | `/contact` | `arise-contact.js` | `arise-contact` |
| 8 | Bible Search | `/arise-bible` | `arise-bible.js` | `arise-bible` |
| 9 | Serve | `/serve` | `arise-form.js` | `arise-form` + attribute `data-form="serve"` |

**Contact:** delete the old Wix form. Its replacement is built into the element.

**Serve:** in the element's settings add a custom attribute — name `data-form`, value `serve`.

---

# STEP 5 — Page code

Only **two** pages need any. Everything else: leave empty or `$w.onReady(() => {});`

### Past Sermons
From **`pages/SERMONS-SERIES-AUTO.md`** — handles live-stream detection *and* the series band.

### Events
From **`pages/EVENTS-SETUP.md`** — feeds real event data to the element.

**Both assume the element's ID is `#customElement1`.** Right-click the element → View Properties to confirm. Wrong ID fails silently.

### masterPage.js
Replace everything with:
```javascript
$w.onReady(() => {});
```

> ⚠️ **Never put custom element code in page code or masterPage.js.** Page code runs server-side first, where `document` and `HTMLElement` don't exist. That's what caused your errors.

---

# STEP 6 — Campus photos

Upload `photos/campus-pineville@2x.jpg` and `photos/campus-alexandria@2x.jpg` to Media Manager.

Then paste their URLs into the constants near the top of **two** files:

```javascript
const CAMPUS_PINEVILLE  = 'paste-url-here';
const CAMPUS_ALEXANDRIA = 'paste-url-here';
```

In `arise-home.js` and `arise-contact.js`. Until you do, they fall back to existing library images — nothing breaks.

**Also delete** `c3b2d0_8a199ddf4578496ab80d396484b004eb` from Media Manager. That was my bad upload.

---

# STEP 7 — The SEO gap (don't skip)

Custom element text is **not in the server HTML**. Right now visitors see everything and Google sees an empty page.

**On the homepage, add native Wix text elements for:**
- An **H1** — "You Belong Here" or "Arise Church"
- **Both campus addresses** — 501 Ates Road, Pineville, LA 71360 · 5305 North Blvd, Alexandria, LA 71301

They can sit discreetly; they just need to exist as real Wix text. **Fifteen minutes.** This is the single most important item here.

The Church structured data I added already covers your service times and both campuses.

---

# STEP 8 — Housekeeping (any time)

**Rename three pages** — Pages → ⋮ → SEO Basics → URL slug. **Say yes to the 301 redirect.**

| From | To |
|---|---|
| `/general-4` | `/lead-network` |
| `/s-projects-basic` | `/training` |
| `/previous-events-1` | `/past-events` |

Then update the `NAV` array in `arise-header.js` and the links in `arise-home.js` and `arise-events.js`.

**Unpublish four:** `/application-form` · `/schedule` · `/devotional` · `/events-2`

**Uninstall Online Programs** — Dashboard → Apps → Manage Apps. Removes six pages at once.

**Clean `/thank-you-page`** — it still has Wix demo data live: "Product option 1/2/3", "$0.00", and a link to `kamille.info`, a domain unconnected to you.

---

|---|---|---|
| `arise-header.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-header` — nav + hamburger side menu |
| `arise-footer.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-footer` |
| `arise-home.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-home` |
| `arise-about.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-about` |
| `arise-leaders.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-leaders` |
| `arise-ministries.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-ministries` |
| `arise-sermons.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-sermons` |
| `arise-events.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-events` |
| `arise-contact.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-contact` — form built in |

| `arise-form.js` | `public/custom-elements/` | `arise-form` — Serve / prayer |
| `http-functions.js` | `backend/` | Form submissions |
| `events.jsw` | `backend/` | Real event data |
| `youtube.jsw` | `backend/` | Live stream + series (optional) |
| `bibleApis.jsw` | `backend/` | **Delete** |

**11 elements. 3 backend files. 2 page-code files. 1 to delete.**

---

# CMS collections — already created

| Collection | Contents |
|---|---|

Caption block bottom of each tile with a gradient behind it: title in Anton 16.5px white, category below in **white at 92%** — *not red*. Photos vary too much in brightness for a small red label to stay legible.

### Section 6 — Latest Message · white

Two columns, 1.15 / 0.85. Left: 16:9 video still with a red circular play button. Right: message title, one-line description, skewed red strip with speaker and service, then an "All Messages" outline button.

### Section 7 — What To Expect · `#0A0A0C`

Kicker "FIRST TIME?" → H2 → three columns, each opening with a 32×4px red bar:

**Parking** — Park wherever there's room. Our parking ushers are out on Sunday mornings.
**What to wear** — There's no dress code. You'll see jeans and you'll see suits.
**When to arrive** — Come a little early your first time.

Then a **Get Directions** button.

### Section 8 — Give · `#D6222D`

Full red band. Kicker, H2, one paragraph, white button with red text.

### Section 9 — Footer · `#0A0A0C`

Three columns — Arise Church / Visit / Connect — over a bottom bar reading `© 2026 Arise Church` and `Sunday 10:30 AM · Both campuses`.

**Remove the information-desk link from the copyright.**

### Section 10 — Service Times custom element

1. Velo sidebar → **Public → custom-elements/** → paste `arise-service-times-final.js` into the file Wix generated
2. **Add → Embed Code → Custom Element**
3. **Choose Source → Velo file** (not Server URL — Velo files have no URL)
4. **Tag Name:** `arise-service-times`
5. Place top-right of the hero, size **360 × 80**
6. **Publish**

**It will look clipped in Editor and Preview.** Wix renders custom elements in an iframe there; only the published site puts it in the real page DOM. Check the live site.

> Your current dropdown says Corporate Prayer **Mon–Wed**. It's **Mon–Thu**. This fixes it.

### Home page checklist

- [ ] Header rebuilt, raw-URL link deleted
- [ ] Hero with scrim, H1, two buttons
- [ ] Sub-line decided
- [ ] Who We Are + four-part pathway
- [ ] Campuses — both, with times
- [ ] Ministries — 4 tiles, 1:1
- [ ] Latest Message

- [ ] Give band
- [ ] Footer, copyright link removed
- [ ] Service Times custom element live
- [ ] Checked on a phone
- [ ] Checked in the **Facebook in-app browser** — this is where the dark-mode problem showed up

**Then tell me.** I'll crawl the live page and verify structure, headings, contrast, and metadata before you move on.

|---|---|---|---|

I'M NEW · ABOUT · MINISTRIES · MEDIA · EVENTS · GET INVOLVED · [GIVE]

1. Red double-dash + uppercase tracked kicker
2. Anton headline, uppercase, 1–2 lines

# AriseCenla.church — Full Site Audit
**Date:** August 17, 2026
**Site:** arisecenla.church (Wix, Editor type, Premium, Velo enabled)
**Scope:** Design, navigation, content, accessibility, SEO, technical
**Changes made:** **None.** Everything below is read-only observation. Nothing was edited.

---

## 0. Headline

The design is solid — you're right about that. The problems aren't visual, they're **structural**. Three things stand out:

1. **The site is far bigger than the menu admits.** 51 pages exist. 9 are in the menu. Entire working features — a store, a giving page, discipleship classes, an online program — are live and unreachable.
2. **Service times exist (custom-coded dropdown) but aren't machine-visible.** *(Corrected — see §3.3.)* They do not appear in the server-rendered HTML of any page I fetched, which is what search engines and directory scrapers read first.
3. **1,099 accessibility findings**, including 2 critical ones, and 12 pages that couldn't even be analyzed.

---

## 1. NAVIGATION & INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

*(Your flagged priority — most of the value is here.)*

### 1.1 The menu shows 7 items; the site has 51 pages

Desktop menu at full width: Home · About (→ Leaders) · Ministries · Events (→ Previous Events) · Past Sermons · Bible Search · Contact (→ Sign Up to Serve) · Log In · GIVE ONLINE

**Correction:** my first pass called "More..." a menu item burying content. It isn't — it's Wix's responsive overflow container, which is present in the DOM and only surfaces when the window is too narrow to fit all items. At full desktop width it doesn't appear. It *will* appear on smaller laptops and tablets, so it still matters at those widths, but it isn't the cause of the problem.

The actual problem is simpler: **7 top-level destinations for 51 pages.** Everything below is unreachable from navigation regardless of overflow behavior.

### 1.2 Live features with zero path from the menu

Found via the site crawl — all of these are published and being served:

| Feature | Evidence | In menu? |
|---|---|---|
| **Wix Stores** — **UNDER CONSTRUCTION but publicly live** | `/product-page/impacttioga-t-shirt`, `/product-page/arise-church-yard-sign`, categories `/apparel`, `/yard-decor`, `/all-products`, `/cart-page` | No — see warning below |
| **`/tithes-and-offerings`** — *intentional redirect to Tithe.ly, used for livestreams and social* | Working as designed | Correctly not in menu |
| **Wix Bookings — classes** | "Pathway to Discipleship – In-Person Class", "Pathway to Discipleship – Online Class" | No |
| **Wix Online Programs** | `/challenges`, `/challenge-page/101af5b6…` | No |
| **Devotional page** | `/devotional` | No |
| **Application form** | `/application-form` | No |
| **Outreach** | `/outreach` (only reachable via one ministry card) | No |
| **Serve signup** | `/serve` (buried under Contact) | Barely |

**Additional pages found in the site router** (second pass, reading the page manifest directly): **Beliefs · Promises · Podcast · Job Board · Training · Classes · Give · Unlimited · Visitor Page · Schedule** (`/schedule` — live, returns 200) · **Devotional** (`/devotional` — live).

A **Podcast** page and a **Job Board** are notable. So are **Beliefs** and **Promises** — the About page has "We Believe" and "We Promise" as bare text with no links, which suggests those pages were built and never wired up.

You have a **store with merch** that no visitor can find from the menu — see the warning immediately below.

### 1.2b ⚠️ The under-construction store is publicly live and crawlable

Confirmed: the store is **under construction** — but its pages are **published and reachable right now**. Wix's scanner crawled them, which means Google can index them too.

Currently live: the Impact Tioga T-Shirt and Arise Church Yard Sign product pages, the Apparel / Yard Decor / All Products category pages, and the cart page.

**Two risks:**
1. Someone finds a product page through search, tries to buy, and hits an unfinished checkout. Bad first impression, and it's a *payment* flow.
2. Google indexes half-built commerce pages under your domain, which is hard to walk back later.

**Recommended (pending your approval):** unpublish the store pages, or set them to `noindex` and remove them from the sitemap until launch. Wix can hide pages without deleting any of your work.

**Correction:** I previously flagged `/tithes-and-offerings` as an orphaned duplicate giving path. **That was wrong** — it's a deliberate redirect to Tithe.ly used as a clean link target for livestreams and social posts. Working as intended. *(One small thing worth deciding: whether that redirect page should be `noindex`, since thin redirect pages in the search index add no value.)*

### 1.3 Leftover template junk that's live and crawlable

- **Wix Portfolio demo content** — `/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio` and `/project-title-6`. These are untouched Wix sample pages.
- `/s-projects-basic` — another default template page.
- `/thank-you-page`, `/payment-request-page` — utility pages, probably fine, but confirm they're not indexable.

### 1.4 Stale content still published

- **"2022 Woman's Conference"** is still a live bookable service.
- **14+ past event pages** live: Kidz Kamp, Father Figure Brunch, Men's Retreat (×2), The Path (×2), Unshakeable Men's Conference, Women of Impact, Women Rising, Women's Retreat (×3 + waitlist), Thrive Lake Day, "flow-1".
- Only **one upcoming event** on `/events`: The Lead Network 2026 Camp Meeting (Fri, Oct 30).
- `/arise-team` is **still in Google's index** but returns **404**. Google's cached copy shows a 2018 footer.

### 1.5 Header oddity

Above the menu on every page there's a link whose **visible text is a raw URL**:
`https://www.arisecenla.church/information-desk-registration`

That same page is also what the **footer copyright links to** on every page. And the page itself **renders no content** — no header, no footer, no body. It's a dead end that appears twice on every page of the site.

### 1.6 Label and grouping problems

- **"Past Sermons"** — the page also carries current announcements (Phase Two launch, baby shower). "Watch" or "Messages" fits better.
- **"Bible Search"** is a tool sitting at the same level as About and Ministries. Belongs under a Resources group.
- **"Sign Up to Serve!"** is nested under Contact. Serving is a next step, not a contact method.
- **"Meet our Leaders"** under About is correct.
- Site name renders as lowercase **"arisechurch"** in every page title, but the brand everywhere else is **"Arise Church"**.

### 1.7 Proposed structure — for discussion only

```
I'M NEW      → Plan Your Visit · What to Expect · Kids · Our Beliefs
ABOUT        → Our Story · Leaders · Locations
MINISTRIES   → (the 8 you have)
MEDIA        → Messages · Devotional · Bible Tool
EVENTS       → Upcoming · Past
GET INVOLVED → Serve · Classes · Programs · Outreach
[ GIVE ]     (button)
[ SHOP ]     (button, if keeping the store)
```

Six items plus two buttons — no overflow, everything reachable in one or two clicks.

---

## 2. ACCESSIBILITY — hard numbers

Ran Wix's official full-site accessibility scan.

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Pages discovered | 51 |
| Pages scanned | 39 |
| **Pages that failed to analyze** | **12** |
| Total findings | **1,099** |
| Critical | **2** |
| Serious | 1,097 |
| Pages affected | 38 of 39 |

**By category:** screen reader 1,080 · alternative text 1,069 · color contrast 19 · heading structure 9 · keyboard 2

### 2.1 The two criticals

Both are `inaccessible-component` — a component that can't provide keyboard or assistive-tech behavior at all (WCAG 4.1.2, Level A).
- **Homepage** (element `comp-jqh1ozf6`)
- **Contact page**

### 2.2 Biggest concentration

**`/sermons` alone accounts for 1,031 of the 1,099 findings.** These are `media-alternatives` — video and audio with no captions, transcripts, or text alternative. 337 distinct media items.

### 2.3 Homepage heading structure

The homepage is flagged for **missing a main heading or skipping heading levels**. "WHO WE ARE" renders as an H2 with no H1 above it. This hurts screen readers *and* SEO.

### 2.4 The 12 pages that couldn't be scanned

`/ministries` · `/serve` · `/outreach` · `/previous-events-1` · `/tithes-and-offerings` · `/book-online` · `/booking-form` · `/cart-page` · `/payment-request-page` · `/s-projects-basic` · 2 booking service pages

Failure code: `ANALYSIS_FAILED`. This usually means the page is heavy or slow enough that the renderer timed out. **Worth treating as a performance red flag**, not just a scanner quirk — `/ministries` is one of your main pages.

---

## 3. CONTENT ERRORS

### 3.1 Leaders page — needs a full copy pass

**The meta description in Google right now literally reads:**
> "Recommended Meta Description for the Meet Our Leaders page: 'Meet the passionate pastors, ministers, and leaders of Arise Church…'"

The AI prompt label got pasted in with the answer. This is live in search results.

**Name mismatches:**
- Heading "Chad and Tabitha **Kerik**" → body says "Chad and Tabitha **Ker**"
- Heading "Will **Robinson**" → body says "Will **Robertson**"

**Truncated sentences (words missing mid-phrase):**
- "a source of ___ and strength for our community"
- "are truly remarkable ___ of our church community"
- "as one of our esteemed ___, leads with passion"
- "contributes to our community in ___ and impactful ways"
- "a committed member of ___ praise and worship team"
- "shine through in all ___ efforts"

**Tone inconsistency:** Bryant Sanders' bio is written in **second person** ("We are truly honored to have **you** lead us… **your** years of dedicated ministry"). Every other bio is third person. It reads like an appreciation card dropped into a staff directory.

**Layout:** Ethan Mayes has **no photo**. Vanessa Sanders' photo is 344×400; everyone else is 251×344.

**Titles:** Vanessa is called both "Pastor" and "Prophet" in one sentence. Bryant is "Apostle." Norman is "elder." No consistent title convention, and the top leader appears second in the list.

**Image filenames = alt text:** `image0 (2).png`, `image2.png`, `image3.png`, `image5.png`, `image6.png`, `image7.png`. Straight off a phone.

### 3.2 Ministries page

**Four of eight "Learn More" buttons are dead** — plain text, no link:
- Thrive For Young Adults
- Mvmt 6:14
- Worship Team
- In Edge / X Edge

Working: Lead Network (→ `/general-4`), Children's, Youth, Outreach.

**"Lead Network" points to `/general-4`** — a default Wix slug. Should be `/lead-network`.

**Image filenames leaking into URLs and alt text:**
- `ChatGPT Image May 14, 2025, 04_36_03 PM.png`
- `515499984_1033890948907446_8820358226701242830_n_edited_edited.jpg` (Facebook download)
- `Untitled design.png`
- `Pasted_Image_t1qdjcue.png`
- `Movment.PNG` — misspelled

### 3.3 Homepage

- Two missing periods: "join our vibrant community Here" and "…each person brings"
- No address, no "plan your visit," no next step for a first-time visitor.
- Prayer Request is a **`mailto:` link**. These fail silently on most phones, and you keep no record of the request.

**CORRECTION — service times.** My first pass said service times appear nowhere. **That was wrong.** They're in a custom-coded "Service Times ▾" dropdown, **top-right of the homepage hero, above the fold.** My method (reading server-rendered HTML) can't see client-side Velo output, so I reported an absence I hadn't established.

**Placement is good.** Above the fold, top-right is a conventional spot for utility info, and "Service Times" is the exact phrase visitors scan for. Three fixable things:

**1. Measured contrast failure.** Sampling the actual pixels of the button:

| Measurement | Ratio | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| White text vs. average panel color | **3.91:1** | Passes AA for large bold text (3.0) · **fails AA for normal text (4.5)** |
| White text vs. lightest 10% of panel | **2.18:1** | **Fails AA at any text size** |

The panel is translucent, so its color is whatever the hero image is behind it. Across that strip of the hero, background luminance ranges from 0.004 to 1.000 — **near the full possible range.** As the hero image changes, or on a different slide of that carousel, the text can land on near-white and become nearly unreadable. This is almost certainly among the 19 `color-contrast` findings in §2.

*Fix:* give the panel a solid or near-solid fill (85–100% opacity) instead of relying on the image behind it. That alone takes it well past 4.5:1 and makes it stable regardless of the background.

**2. It's collapsed by default.** The single most-searched fact about a church costs a click. Service times are 2–4 short lines — there's room to show them expanded. Keep the control for a full schedule, but let the core times render immediately.

**3. It's not in the server-rendered HTML.** The complete server-rendered text of the homepage is: nav → "WHO WE ARE" → welcome paragraph → prayer quote → footer. **No time strings anywhere.** Crawlers read that first; Google runs JavaScript on a slower, less reliable second pass, and collapsed content is deprioritized regardless. Third-party directories publishing invented hours is weak circumstantial support that they didn't see yours either.

*Fix:* keep the dropdown, and **also** emit the times as plain text plus JSON-LD (§12). Additive, not a redesign.

### 3.3b Homepage carousel is the critical accessibility failure

The critical finding `comp-jqh1ozf6` is a **stock Wix media Carousel rendered inside an iframe** (`Carousel.b605841e.html`) — not custom code. Carousels rendered that way can't expose keyboard or screen-reader behavior, which is why it trips WCAG 4.1.2 Level A.

### 3.3c Header branding

The header wordmark is **"# YouBelongHere"** — the church's name doesn't appear in the header at all. It's a strong tagline, but a first-time visitor landing from a search result has no name-level confirmation they're in the right place until they scroll to the logo in the hero.

### 3.4 Two campuses — the site never says so

**CORRECTION:** I flagged Pineville / Tioga / Alexandria as a three-town contradiction. It isn't. **Tioga is a town inside Pineville**, so "Impact Tioga" and the Pineville branding are consistent. And the two addresses are **two real campuses**:

| Campus | Address | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Main** | 501 Ates Road, Pineville, LA 71360 | Primary |
| **Second** | 5305 North Blvd, Alexandria, LA 71301 | Second campus |

**The real problem is that a visitor can't tell any of this.** The Contact page has an **"Our Locations" heading with nothing under it**, then two bare addresses with no labels, no campus names, and no indication which is main. Nothing anywhere else on the site mentions being multi-campus.

A two-campus church needs this to be obvious — it changes where someone drives on Sunday. Recommended: a real **Locations** page (or a Locations section in the nav), each campus with its own name, address, map, times, and photo.

### 3.4b Confirmed service times

| When | What |
|---|---|
| **Sunday 10:30am** | Service |
| **Monday 7pm** | — |
| **Wednesday 7pm** | — |
| **Monday–Thursday 5am** | Corporate Prayer |

These now need to land in three places: the existing dropdown (already done), plain text in the page body, and JSON-LD structured data (§12). *Pending: whether both campuses share this schedule, and what the Monday/Wednesday 7pm gatherings are called.*

### 3.5 Contact info sprawl — four addresses

- `info.arisenow@gmail.com` — Wix site contact setting
- `arisenow.church@gmail.com` — Contact page
- `arisechurchprayer@gmail.com` — Prayer request
- `(318) 640-1865`

All gmail, on a premium plan with a custom domain. Also, the Contact page renders the email address **as an H2 heading**, which is semantically wrong.

### 3.6 Third-party listings are publishing confirmed misinformation

**Both of these are now confirmed wrong by Bradly:**

| Listings say | Reality |
|---|---|
| Lead Pastor **Chad Stecker** | **No longer connected to the church** |
| **Assemblies of God** | **Independent** — no longer affiliated |

This isn't a stale-data nitpick anymore. Directories with real search visibility are naming a former leader and a denomination you've left. Someone searching "Arise Church Pineville" can land on these before they ever reach your site.

Sites carrying it: JoinMyChurch, UnitedStatesChurches, YellowPages, FindOpen, Wikizer, PlaceDigger.

FindOpen also publishes hours you never set (Sun 9:00–13:00, Tue 18:30–20:00, Wed 18:30–20:30) — all wrong against the confirmed schedule in §3.4b.

**Priority: high.** Claim Google Business Profile first (it feeds many others), then work down the list. Both campuses need their own profile.

---

## 4. SEO

| Issue | Detail |
|---|---|
| Missing meta descriptions | `/contact`, `/arise-bible`, `/information-desk-registration` |
| Broken meta description | `/leaders` (contains the AI prompt label) |
| Weak title | "Contact \| arisechurch" — no city, no keywords |
| Brand inconsistency | Lowercase "arisechurch" in all titles |
| 404 in index | `/arise-team` needs a 301 redirect |
| No structured data | No Church / LocalBusiness JSON-LD found — this is what powers Google's service-times panel |
| Social links inconsistent | Homepage: FB, IG, Twitter. Contact: FB, Twitter, IG, YouTube. Twitter icons still branded Twitter, not X. |
| Thin homepage | Very little indexable text for your most important page |

---

## 5. UPGRADES & ENHANCEMENTS

### Tier 1 — fast, free, high impact
1. **Make the existing service times machine-readable.** Keep the dropdown; additionally emit the times as plain text in the page body (and in JSON-LD, §12) so crawlers and scrapers get them without a click. Adding the address alongside them is the natural pairing.
2. **"Plan Your Visit" page** — times, parking, what to wear, what happens with kids, who to look for.
3. Fix the 4 dead "Learn More" buttons.
4. Full copy pass on Leaders (names, truncated sentences, meta description, Ethan's photo).
5. 301 redirect `/arise-team`.
6. Delete Portfolio demo content and `/s-projects-basic`.
7. Fix the raw-URL link in the header.
8. Alt-text pass on the top 8 pages.

### Tier 2 — structural
9. Nav restructure (§1.7).
10. Surface the store, giving page, classes, and programs.
11. Move email to `@arisecenla.church` addresses.
12. **Add Church schema markup** — Velo is already enabled, so JSON-LD can be injected sitewide. This is what gets service times into Google's sidebar.
13. **Captions/transcripts on sermons** — YouTube auto-captions can be pulled and attached. Clears the majority of your 1,099 findings and makes sermons searchable.
14. Convert Prayer Request from `mailto:` to a real Wix Form.
15. Claim and correct Google Business Profile and the directory listings.
16. Investigate why 12 pages fail to render for the scanner.

### Tier 3 — bigger plays
17. Live-stream embed on the homepage that appears during service.
18. Sermon archive with notes, scripture references, and series grouping.
19. Wix Members Area is installed — is it doing anything?
20. Wix Multilingual is installed but the site is English-only. For a self-described multicultural church, Spanish is an obvious opportunity.
21. Wix Chat is installed — an unmonitored chat widget is worse than none.
22. Consolidate giving: one path, not two.

---

## 6. INSTALLED APPS — usage check

Installed: Promote SEO · Bookings · Chat · Events & Tickets · Forms · Forms & Payments · Groups · Invoices · Members Area · **Multilingual** · Online Programs · Pay Links · **Portfolio** · Stores · Video

Several look installed-but-idle (**Portfolio** is definitely just demo content). Every unused app adds page weight and clutter. Worth an audit of which ones earn their place.

**Additional pages found in the site router** (second pass, reading the page manifest directly): **Beliefs · Promises · Podcast · Job Board · Training · Classes · Give · Unlimited · Visitor Page · Schedule** (`/schedule` — live, returns 200) · **Devotional** (`/devotional` — live).

A **Podcast** page and a **Job Board** are notable. So are **Beliefs** and **Promises** — the About page has "We Believe" and "We Promise" as bare text with no links, which suggests those pages were built and never wired up.

You have a **store with merch** that no visitor can find from the menu — see the warning immediately below.

### 1.2b ⚠️ The under-construction store is publicly live and crawlable

Confirmed: the store is **under construction** — but its pages are **published and reachable right now**. Wix's scanner crawled them, which means Google can index them too.

Currently live: the Impact Tioga T-Shirt and Arise Church Yard Sign product pages, the Apparel / Yard Decor / All Products category pages, and the cart page.

**Two risks:**
1. Someone finds a product page through search, tries to buy, and hits an unfinished checkout. Bad first impression, and it's a *payment* flow.
2. Google indexes half-built commerce pages under your domain, which is hard to walk back later.

**Recommended (pending your approval):** unpublish the store pages, or set them to `noindex` and remove them from the sitemap until launch. Wix can hide pages without deleting any of your work.

**Correction:** I previously flagged `/tithes-and-offerings` as an orphaned duplicate giving path. **That was wrong** — it's a deliberate redirect to Tithe.ly used as a clean link target for livestreams and social posts. Working as intended. *(One small thing worth deciding: whether that redirect page should be `noindex`, since thin redirect pages in the search index add no value.)*

### 1.3 Leftover template junk that's live and crawlable

- **Wix Portfolio demo content** — `/portfolio-collections/my-portfolio` and `/project-title-6`. These are untouched Wix sample pages.
- `/s-projects-basic` — another default template page.
- `/thank-you-page`, `/payment-request-page` — utility pages, probably fine, but confirm they're not indexable.

### 1.4 Stale content still published

- **"2022 Woman's Conference"** is still a live bookable service.
- **14+ past event pages** live: Kidz Kamp, Father Figure Brunch, Men's Retreat (×2), The Path (×2), Unshakeable Men's Conference, Women of Impact, Women Rising, Women's Retreat (×3 + waitlist), Thrive Lake Day, "flow-1".
- Only **one upcoming event** on `/events`: The Lead Network 2026 Camp Meeting (Fri, Oct 30).
- `/arise-team` is **still in Google's index** but returns **404**. Google's cached copy shows a 2018 footer.

### 1.5 Header oddity

Above the menu on every page there's a link whose **visible text is a raw URL**:
`https://www.arisecenla.church/information-desk-registration`

That same page is also what the **footer copyright links to** on every page. And the page itself **renders no content** — no header, no footer, no body. It's a dead end that appears twice on every page of the site.

### 1.6 Label and grouping problems

- **"Past Sermons"** — the page also carries current announcements (Phase Two launch, baby shower). "Watch" or "Messages" fits better.
- **"Bible Search"** is a tool sitting at the same level as About and Ministries. Belongs under a Resources group.
- **"Sign Up to Serve!"** is nested under Contact. Serving is a next step, not a contact method.
- **"Meet our Leaders"** under About is correct.
- Site name renders as lowercase **"arisechurch"** in every page title, but the brand everywhere else is **"Arise Church"**.

### 1.7 Proposed structure — for discussion only

```
I'M NEW      → Plan Your Visit · What to Expect · Kids · Our Beliefs
ABOUT        → Our Story · Leaders · Locations
MINISTRIES   → (the 8 you have)
MEDIA        → Messages · Devotional · Bible Tool
EVENTS       → Upcoming · Past
GET INVOLVED → Serve · Classes · Programs · Outreach
[ GIVE ]     (button)
[ SHOP ]     (button, if keeping the store)
```

Six items plus two buttons — no overflow, everything reachable in one or two clicks.
